data.statement: One model pooled across all cities and trained with an absolute-error (median) objective will beat the hand-set pooled trend on mean raw score in lead years 4–7 without losing years 1–3. Its training rows come from earlier forecast origins inside each fold (origin ≤ cut-off − horizon). Its target is the future value minus the 30-year mean at the origin. Its features are the recent-window means minus the 30-year mean, the pooled slope × lead, CDD per degree, city variability, data quality, location and horizon. It learns horizon-dependent trend damping and window weights.
